```{r}
#| label: load-packages-r
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(nanoparquet)
library(glmnet)
library(nnet)
library(tidymodels)
library(scales)

# The factor zoo of lectures 10 to 14
sample_start <- ymd("1973-01-01")
sample_end <- ymd("2023-12-31")
test_start <- ymd("2000-01-01")
n_folds <- 5
ridge_lambdas <- 10^seq(-7, -1, by = 0.25)
lasso_lambdas <- 10^seq(-6, -2.5, by = 0.25)
macro_names <- c("dp", "tbl", "tms", "dfy", "svar")
few_factors <- 5
phi_rp <- 10
n_trees <- 100
forest_grid <- expand_grid(mtry = c(1, 3, 7), min_n = c(500, 2000))

months_per_year <- 12

# Test sample in labels, e.g. 2000–2023
test_years <- paste0(year(test_start), "–", year(sample_end))

# Colours of the slides, used by the figures
ku_red <- "#901A1E"
jet <- "#3d3d3d"
grey <- "#666666"
light <- "#e6e3df"
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
)

source("lecture-slides/_live-poll.R")
scoreboard_survey <- "aef27-ex08-scoreboard"
```

```{r}
#| label: lectures-10-to-14-code
#| include: false
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr list(ridge_lambdas, lasso_lambdas, few_factors, phi_rp, n_trees, forest_grid, macro_names, sample_end)
# Every row of the scoreboard, with the code of lectures 10 to 14
osap_url <- paste0(
  "https://huggingface.co/datasets/OpenSourceAP/CrossSection/resolve/",
  "Data-Release-2026.10/Portfolios/Full%20Sets%20OP/PredictorLSretWide.parquet"
)
osap_file <- "data/osap_long_short_returns.parquet"
if (!file.exists(osap_file)) download.file(osap_url, osap_file, mode = "wb")
anomalies <- read_parquet(osap_file) |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(as.Date(date), "month")) |>
  filter(between(date, sample_start, sample_end)) |>
  select(date, where(\(x) !anyNA(x)))
returns <- as.matrix(select(anomalies, -date)) / 100
estimation <- anomalies$date < test_start
x_estimation <- returns[estimation, ]

sharpe_ratio <- function(x) mean(x) / sd(x) * sqrt(months_per_year)
portfolio_sharpe <- function(weights) {
  c(
    estimation = sharpe_ratio(returns[estimation, ] %*% weights),
    test = sharpe_ratio(returns[!estimation, ] %*% weights)
  )
}
ridge_weights <- function(x, lambda) {
  solve(crossprod(x) + nrow(x) * lambda * diag(ncol(x)), colSums(x))
}
lasso_weights <- function(x, lambda) {
  fit <- glmnet(
    x, rep(1, nrow(x)), lambda = lambda, intercept = FALSE, standardize = FALSE,
    control = list(thresh = 1e-12)
  )
  as.vector(coef(fit))[-1]
}
pc_lasso_weights <- function(x, lambda) {
  components <- eigen(cov(x), symmetric = TRUE)$vectors
  components %*% lasso_weights(x %*% components, lambda)
}
factor_weights <- function(x, k, phi = 0) {
  mu <- colMeans(x)
  loadings <- eigen(cov(x) + phi * tcrossprod(mu), symmetric = TRUE)$vectors[, seq_len(k), drop = FALSE]
  factors <- x %*% loadings
  loadings %*% solve(cov(factors), colMeans(factors))
}
folds <- ceiling(seq_len(nrow(x_estimation)) / (nrow(x_estimation) / n_folds))
cv_sharpe <- function(fit_weights, lambda) {
  map_dbl(seq_len(n_folds), \(k) {
    weights <- fit_weights(x_estimation[folds != k, ], lambda)
    sharpe_ratio(x_estimation[folds == k, ] %*% weights)
  }) |>
    mean(na.rm = TRUE)
}
choose <- function(fit_weights, lambdas) lambdas[which.max(map_dbl(lambdas, \(l) cv_sharpe(fit_weights, l)))]

market <- read_parquet("data/factors_ff3_monthly.parquet") |>
  filter(between(date, sample_start, sample_end))
ridge_lambda <- choose(ridge_weights, ridge_lambdas)
lasso_lambda <- choose(lasso_weights, lasso_lambdas)
pc_lasso_lambda <- choose(pc_lasso_weights, lasso_lambdas)
static_weights <- list(
  "1/N over all anomalies" = rep(1 / ncol(returns), ncol(returns)),
  "Plug-in mean-variance" = ridge_weights(x_estimation, 0),
  "Ridge (prior on Sharpe ratios)" = ridge_weights(x_estimation, ridge_lambda),
  "Lasso on anomalies" = lasso_weights(x_estimation, lasso_lambda),
  "Lasso on principal components" = pc_lasso_weights(x_estimation, pc_lasso_lambda),
  "PCA, 5 factors" = factor_weights(x_estimation, few_factors),
  "RP-PCA, 5 factors" = factor_weights(x_estimation, few_factors, phi_rp)
)

# Forecasts of lectures 13 and 14, used as expected returns each month
macro <- read_parquet("data/macro_predictors.parquet") |>
  transmute(date = date %m+% months(1), across(all_of(macro_names))) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(macro_names), \(x) (x - mean(x[date < test_start])) / sd(x[date < test_start])))
panel <- anomalies |>
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "anomaly", values_to = "ret") |>
  mutate(ret = ret / 100) |>
  arrange(anomaly, date) |>
  mutate(
    ret_lag_1 = lag(ret),
    momentum_12 = slider::slide_dbl(lag(ret), mean, .before = 11, .complete = TRUE),
    .by = anomaly
  ) |>
  left_join(macro, join_by(date)) |>
  drop_na()
train <- panel |>
  filter(date < test_start) |>
  mutate(block = ceiling(dense_rank(date) / (n_distinct(date) / n_folds)))
features <- c("ret_lag_1", "momentum_12", macro_names)

forest_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_formula(ret ~ ret_lag_1 + momentum_12 + dp + tbl + tms + dfy + svar) |>
  add_model(
    rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = n_trees) |>
      set_engine("ranger", seed = 2027) |>
      set_mode("regression")
  )
forest_tuning <- tune_grid(
  forest_workflow, resamples = group_vfold_cv(train, group = block, v = n_folds), grid = forest_grid
)
forest_fit <- forest_workflow |>
  finalize_workflow(select_best(forest_tuning, metric = "rmse")) |>
  fit(train)
centers <- colMeans(train[features])
input_sd <- apply(train[features], 2, sd)
scale_inputs <- function(data) scale(as.matrix(data[features]), centers, input_sd)
ret_sd <- sd(train$ret)
fit_network <- function(data, decay, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  nnet(scale_inputs(data), data$ret / ret_sd, size = 5, decay = decay, linout = TRUE, maxit = 500, trace = FALSE)
}
fitting <- filter(train, date < ymd("1995-01-01"))
validation <- filter(train, date >= ymd("1995-01-01"))
decays <- c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)
decay <- decays[which.min(map_dbl(decays, \(d) {
  mean((validation$ret - predict(fit_network(fitting, d, 1), scale_inputs(validation)) * ret_sd)^2)
}))]
network_forecast <- map(1:5, \(seed) as.vector(predict(fit_network(train, decay, seed), scale_inputs(panel))) * ret_sd) |>
  reduce(`+`) / 5
forecasts <- list(
  "Forecasts: OLS" = predict(lm(ret ~ ret_lag_1 + momentum_12 + dp + tbl + tms + dfy + svar, data = train), panel),
  "Forecasts: random forest" = predict(forest_fit, panel)$.pred,
  "Forecasts: neural network" = network_forecast
)
covariance <- cov(x_estimation)
forecast_weights <- map(forecasts, \(forecast) {
  panel |>
    mutate(forecast = forecast) |>
    select(date, anomaly, forecast) |>
    nest(data = -date) |>
    mutate(weights = map(data, \(d) {
      as.vector(solve(covariance + ridge_lambda * diag(ncol(returns)), d$forecast[match(colnames(returns), d$anomaly)]))
    })) |>
    select(date, weights)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: scoreboard-rows
#| include: false
# Weights each month: constant for the SDF portfolios, new each month for forecasts
monthly_weights <- c(
  map(static_weights, \(w) {
    tibble(
      date = anomalies$date,
      weights = rep(list(as.vector(w)), nrow(anomalies))
    )
  }),
  forecast_weights
)
month_index <- match(monthly_weights[[1]]$date, anomalies$date)

# Turnover between anomalies: weights scaled to a gross position of 1, and the
# weights of last month after they drifted with last month's returns
turnover <- imap(monthly_weights, \(m, portfolio) {
  rows <- match(m$date, anomalies$date)
  gross <- map(m$weights, \(w) w / sum(abs(w)))
  map_dbl(seq_along(gross)[-1], \(t) {
    drifted <- gross[[t - 1]] * (1 + returns[rows[t - 1], ])
    sum(abs(gross[[t]] - drifted / sum(abs(drifted))))
  }) |>
    tibble(date = m$date[-1], turnover = _, portfolio = portfolio)
}) |>
  bind_rows()

realized <- imap(monthly_weights, \(m, portfolio) {
  rows <- match(m$date, anomalies$date)
  tibble(
    date = m$date,
    portfolio = portfolio,
    ret = map2_dbl(m$weights, rows, \(w, r) sum(w * returns[r, ]))
  )
}) |>
  bind_rows()

cpz_runs <- read_csv(
  "lecture-slides/factor-zoo/results/cpz_light_runs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(seeds == 9) |>
  mutate(
    model = if_else(
      str_detect(model, "Chen"),
      "Chen–Pelger–Zhu light",
      "Feed-forward SDF"
    )
  ) |>
  slice_max(sr_valid, n = 1, by = model)

scoreboard <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    portfolio = "Market",
    estimation = sharpe_ratio(market$mkt_excess[market$date < test_start]),
    test = sharpe_ratio(market$mkt_excess[market$date >= test_start])
  ),
  realized |>
    summarize(
      estimation = sharpe_ratio(ret[date < test_start]),
      test = sharpe_ratio(ret[date >= test_start]),
      .by = portfolio
    ),
  cpz_runs |>
    transmute(portfolio = model, estimation = sr_estimation, test = sr_test)
) |>
  left_join(
    turnover |>
      filter(date >= test_start) |>
      summarize(turnover = mean(turnover), .by = portfolio),
    join_by(portfolio)
  )

if (live) {
  ojs_define(
    poll_base = poll_base,
    scoreboard_survey = scoreboard_survey,
    ridge_test = scoreboard$test[
      scoreboard$portfolio == "Ridge (prior on Sharpe ratios)"
    ],
    test_years = test_years
  )
}
```

# What the portfolios trade

## Turnover

```{r}
#| label: plot-turnover
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.6
turnover_shown <- c(
  "Ridge (prior on Sharpe ratios)",
  "RP-PCA, 5 factors",
  "Lasso on anomalies",
  "Forecasts: OLS",
  "Forecasts: random forest",
  "Forecasts: neural network"
)
scoreboard |>
  filter(portfolio %in% turnover_shown) |>
  mutate(
    portfolio = fct_reorder(portfolio, turnover),
    kind = if_else(
      str_starts(portfolio, "Forecasts"),
      "New weights every month",
      "Constant weights"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = turnover, y = portfolio, fill = kind)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(turnover, 1)), hjust = -0.15, size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Constant weights" = "#b3b3b3",
      "New weights every month" = ku_red
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste("Turnover between anomalies per month,", test_years),
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5))
```

- **Between anomalies:** weights scaled to a gross position of 1. Constant SDF weights only trade back after the anomalies drift; forecasts change the weights every month
- **Inside each anomaly:** every long-short portfolio is itself rebalanced. Our returns are before these costs. For comparison, the decile portfolios of Gu, Kelly & Xiu turn over 111% to 152% of their value a month with machine learning forecasts, 58% with OLS-3 (value-weighted, their Table 8)

## The implementable efficient frontier

- **Jensen, Kelly, Malamud & Pedersen:** judge a strategy by its return **after trading costs** at each level of risk, the *implementable efficient frontier*
- In their stock-level data, forecasts that ignore costs lean on short-lived characteristics: what looks best before costs trades the most
- Better: learn the **portfolio weights** directly, with the trading costs in the objective. The same idea as the cost-aware weights of lecture 5, now with machine learning
- *Economic feature importance:* which characteristics still matter after costs
